membership_file.row_format: one lowercase canonical H3 string per line; valid H3 cell at entry resolution
membership_file.terminal_newline: required for nonempty file; empty set is zero bytes
membership_file.sha256: SHA256 of exact file bytes; matches grid_registry.memberships[].sha256
membership_file.count: number of IDs; matches entry count; no blank lines

path_base: directory containing selected study config; relative_path resolves against that directory, not CWD or toolkit; must remain beneath configured resolved data_root

roles.water_reporting: cells whose polygons intersect qualified coastal-plus-inland mask in strictly positive ellipsoidal area; include mixed boundary cells; exclude zero-area touches; never center-only
roles.land_source: cells with positive-area land overlap inside explicit producer source extent; mixed cells retained
roles.water_source: cells with positive-area water overlap inside explicit producer source extent; may extend beyond reporting mask
roles.rectangle: planning support only; never substitute for qualified water_reporting

source_support: Each owner defines scientifically required support using existing producer_buffers. Membership role separates source support from reporting. Native raster/grid/catchment extent manifests stay distinct; an H3 source file does not replace complete native terrain paths or meteorological stencils. No unapproved single common halo.

identity.mask: grid_registry.mask_revision + mask_sha256 pin qualified mask; mask hash policy recorded in mask manifest
identity.geometry: domain.geometry_sha256 identifies planning rectangle only, NOT water mask
identity.library: record H3 library version and cell polygon/area engine and CRS transform in adjacent producer manifest
identity.sources: record raw source/member SHA256, native CRS, source dates/accuracy, geometry operation and source halo identity in adjacent mask/support manifest; config schema unchanged

consumer_validation: match mask revision/hash and entry resolution/role
resolve safe artifact path; require existing readable file
reject duplicate/unsorted/noncanonical IDs; validate H3 cell and resolution
use actual listed IDs; no bbox/center fallback
support role and reporting role remain distinct cache keys; bind source extent/producer buffer identities to manifests
current_real_registry_status: pending_validated_marine_mask; no qualified membership files produced
